dedupe_keys.name: corrai model calibration and sensitivity tools

description: Corrai is a Python package from the Building Energy Simulation Tools contributors for model calibration, sampling, sensitivity analysis and surrogate modelling. It wraps analytical functions, external simulators and Modelica FMUs in a common model interface. Users define parameter ranges, model properties and simulation periods, then obtain experiment results, sensitivity indices, calibrated parameters or statistical surrogates. Coverage is domain-independent and globally configurable, with temporal detail controlled by the wrapped model. Public source, pip installation and a worked sensitivity example are free under BSD-3-Clause, with Python 3.10 or newer required. A limitation is that surrogate accuracy and sensitivity conclusions depend on sampled ranges, training outputs and the underlying simulator. External FMUs and optimisation dependencies also require compatible setup and their own terms. Corrai can organise calibration and uncertainty studies around building-energy simulations, complementary to EnergyPlus (model-energyplus). The README documents supported samplers, optimisation routes and error metrics. No FMU, training set or simulation dependency was downloaded, and no calibration was run.
